Home.title: Move to Green with Motorcare
Home.content:
It's our ambition to be a green company and move people to green transportation solutions.

One of our standout initiatives is the introduction of fully electric vehicles across all our brands. In a market where electric vehicles are still emerging, we've been pioneers in bringing this environmentally friendly option through our move to green campaign, reducing the carbon footprint of our offerings.

Green.heroTitle: Transform the Automotive Future with Sustainability
Green.heroDescription: Join MotorCare's Green movement and discover how sustainable innovation is revolutionizing the automotive industry — every electric kilometer is a victory against climate change.
Green.introDescription: We lead the sustainable transformation in the automotive industry through innovation, clean technology, and environmental responsibility.

cleanEnergy.title: Clean Energy
cleanEnergy.description: Commitment to renewable and self-sufficient energy sources.

globalImpact.title: Global Impact
globalImpact.description: Pioneering stations and projects in Africa and beyond.

Green.visionDescription: Since 2003, KJAER GROUP has been a pioneer in sustainability. MOVE to Green is the evolution of this commitment, focused on creating an ecosystem of green mobility and energy consumption.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: The transformation lies in consuming more renewable energy and focusing on our own carbon footprint, such as solar energy and changing work habits.

mobility.title: Mobility
mobility.description: Transforming vehicle fleets from fossil fuel to hybrid and/or electric, including e-scooters and EVs (electric vehicles).

Green.chargingTitle: Smart Charging for an Electric Future
Green.chargingDescription: The transition to EVs requires a robust charging infrastructure. MOVE to Green is building this network, with AC and DC charging stations and innovative projects like the solar carport.

dcCharging.title: DC Charging
dcCharging.description: 25 kWh fast charging stations installed in Maputo and Kampala, with ChadeMo and CCS2 plugs.

solarCarport.title: Solar Carport
solarCarport.description: Innovative project in partnership with G-Sol Energy for 100% green and self-sufficient charging through solar energy.

firstStation.title: First Station
firstStation.description: We inaugurated the first EV charging station in Maputo, Mozambique, pioneering in the African market.

Green.ctaDescription: We are building a legacy of sustainability and innovation. Your participation is essential to accelerate the transition to a carbon neutral world. Get in touch and discover how you can contribute.

About.info: At the forefront of automotive solutions in Mozambique since 1996
About.about_info:
Motorcare has been providing automotive services to businesses in Mozambique since 1996.
As an authorized distributor of premium brands, Motorcare delivers excellent automotive solutions, including genuine parts and accessories, as well as specialized maintenance and repair services, complemented by a full range of fleet management solutions.
Motorcare's national presence extends to the cities of Maputo, Beira, Nampula, Pemba, and Moatize.
Motorcare aims to grow its business profitably and responsibly, promoting social and environmental goals aligned with international standards and certifications.
About.mission_description1: Create a high-performance environment where the contributions of employees, customers, and business partners are valued and respected.
About.mission_description2: Develop a portfolio of innovative brands and services that outperforms the competition and delivers the greatest possible value in how we work.
About.vision_description: Provide pioneering automotive solutions in emerging economies.
About.values_description1:
Professionalism: 
We act with rigor and competence in everything we do — this is how we conduct our business and interact with each other.
About.values_description2:
Respect: 
Mutual respect between colleagues, partners, customers, and all stakeholders is a fundamental principle for us.
About.values_description3:
Honesty: 
We handle all business matters with maximum transparency. We are trustworthy and honor our promises and commitments.
About.values_description4:
Dedication: 
We believe that the success of our customers and partners is essential to our own success.
About.nissan: As an authorized Nissan vehicle dealership, MOTORCARE offers top automotive solutions, genuine parts, accessories, as well as access to after-sales services like preventive and corrective maintenance. We offer solutions for both B2B and B2C segments.
About.renault:
MOTORCARE Lda has been operating successfully in Mozambique since 1996. It is the official distributor of Renault Trucks, having built a solid reputation for reliability over the years.
MOTORCARE provides quality Sales and After-Sales Services through its national network of branches strategically located in Maputo, Moatize, Nampula, Pemba and Biera to ensure quality solutions to your business needs.
About.niu: Instead of waiting for the market to request the green change, Motorcare LDA now offers you the NIU zero emission mobility choice in a convenient plug-and-go solution. NIU is the affordable green mode of transport that feels fantastic to drive and even better to be green.
About.continental: MOTORCARE Lda is the accredited distributor of Continental Tyre in Mozambique. We offer a wide range of technologically advanced tyres, competitive pricing and quality service without compromise of safety. Trust the MOTORCARE fitment professionals to provide you the best tyre solutions in Mozambique.
About.general: MOTORCARE , the authorised distributor of GENERAL TIRES has the tyre solution for your tyre requirements. Be it the hardcore Grabber GT and Grabber AT tyre for rock, sand and mud or the comfort and speed of the Altimax Comfort and Altimax Sport. With MOTORCARE and GENERAL TIRE anywhere is possible.
About.maxxis: Maxxis is dedicated to making tires riders and drivers can trust for quality and performance. Trust in Maxxis extends from average consumers to professional drivers and riders, who rely on us to win world and national championships. At Motorcare you can find all Maxxis products.
About.cst: Motorcare also has one of the best tire companies. Utilising a first-rate manufacturing operation and highly efficient logistics, CST sets the standard for excellence in the tire industry.
About.history_info: MOTORCARE Mozambique was founded in 1996 by the KJAER GROUP, a Danish company that provides transport solutions in over 70 countries. Motorcare Mozambique's passion and commitment to delivering high-quality transportation and complete vehicle solutions have solidified its position in the emerging transportation market. We are present in Maputo, Beira, Nampula, Moatize, and Pemba.
About.1996-info: Motorcare starts operations in Mozambique, in Matola.
About.2000-info: Relocation of headquarters from Matola to Maputo.
About.2008-info: Opening of branches in Beira and Nampula.
About.2014-info: Launch of new facilities in Moatize and Pemba.
About.2023-info: Restructuring and upgrading of Maputo, Beira, and Nampula branches.
About.certification_info: Motorcare provides services and products in accordance with international standards for health, safety, environment, and quality. Therefore, it has an Integrated Management System based on three international standards: ISO 45001 (Health & Safety), ISO 14001 (Environment), and ISO 9001 (Quality), which are audited annually both internally and externally by an international body. ISO 14001 is an international standard that allows companies to demonstrate their commitment to environmental protection by managing the environmental risks associated with their activities. ISO 9001 aims to ensure greater quality in product or service delivery, focusing on the company’s strategic management. This enables improved operational efficiency and Customer Satisfaction.

Request.info: Pioneering automotive solutions in Mozambique since 1996
Request.service_content:
At Motorcare, providing maintenance services — whether preventive or corrective — is a top priority. Our modern workshops are equipped to handle large volumes of vehicles efficiently and with quality.
You can count on us for competent and transparent service — that’s how we do business and take care of our customers.
Book your service with us and ensure the best care for your vehicle.
Request.test_drive_content:
Want to try the vehicle before deciding?
Fill out the form and book your test drive with us.
Request.peaces_content:
Motorcare is committed to maximum customer satisfaction, which is why we work exclusively with genuine parts, certified by the manufacturer (OEM) and backed by ISO 9001 certification issued by Bureau Veritas.
In addition to parts, we offer a wide range of vehicle accessories, ensuring quality, durability, and full compatibility.
Our commitment is to always provide reliable solutions that guarantee the best performance and safety for your vehicle.
